newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Korea Zinc sees refinery start soon.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Korea Zinc sees refinery start soon.

text.p: Korea Zinc Australia Ltd said on Wednesday it plans to start a 30-month construction period in April or May for a new zinc smelter near Townsville, Queensland.
"Site works for the new refinery are expected to start in April-May this year," Paul Salmon, general manager of the Korea Zinc Co Ltd subsidiary, told Reuters.
Salmon said the construction period takes into account possible delays resulting from heavy seasonal rains that normally occur in Queensland from around November to March.
Production from the new refinery was still on track to begin in the second half of 1999, he said.

The Australian government last year gave environmental approval for development of the first stage of the smelter, estimated to cost A$500 million and capable of producing around 170,000 tonnes of zinc a year.
A stage two development at a later date could double the smelter's production capacity, Korea Zinc has said.
